catalyst.name: Networked Targeting, D.A.R.C.I. Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Passively grants 20 Stability.
Hits on Highlighted targets grants one stack of 'Networked Targeting' to you and allies within a 15 meter radius for 10.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.
Networked Targeting buffs D.A.R.C.I and Non-Exotic Sniper Rifles.
Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2.8%|6.1%|9.1%|12.5%|15.9% increased damage
• ? Stability, Handling, Aim Assist, Flinch Resistance
Granting the 5th stack to an ally increases D.A.R.C.I's damage by an additional 15%.
